rationale: Both Shiza and Shan are building at the intersection of humanoid robotics and embodied AI—Shiza as a founder of Haptile (with direct 1X experience on robot joints and bodies) and Shan as Director at Ruyi Dynamics, which operates a full-stack embodied AI and robotics platform. They share domain expertise in computer vision and hardware-software integration, and could explore how their approaches to robotics subsystems and deployment might complement each other.
intro_message: Shiza Charania, meet Shan — you're both deep in humanoid robotics and embodied AI; Shiza's coming from mechanical engineering on 1X's robot subsystems and Shan's leading full-stack robotics at Ruyi Dynamics.
